region.why: a deployment fact: HCAZERRS ASSIGNs SYSID into the message it writes; the corpus names no region

notes: The example-health-apis prescription writer HCMADB02, LINKed with a COMMAREA: after the length checks it walks the start..end dates and INSERTs one PRESCRIPTION row per dose (CA-FREQUENCY 1..4 a day). Scenarios stay with frequency 1 (12:00): the frequency 2..4 arms start with MOVE 08000000 TO WS-START-NUM-TIME, which the det port moves as 8000000 (hour 80), a port blocker (P127), so no scenario reaches them yet. Tables come from the estate's @DB2CRE.jcl (HCZMSA1). Derived from IBM's example-health-apis (github.com/ibm/example-health-apis, Apache-2.0; (C) Copyright IBM Corp. 2011, 2014): LICENSE here is the corpus's own, NOTICE names the source and what was derived.

scenarios.name: one-a-day-one-day
scenarios.why: frequency 1, a one-day span: one PRESCRIPTION row

scenarios.name: one-a-day-three-days
scenarios.why: frequency 1 over three days: the PERFORM UNTIL loop runs three times

scenarios.name: other-frequency
scenarios.why: frequency matches no WHEN: loop advances, no row

scenarios.name: end-before-start
scenarios.why: end date before start: the loop is not entered, no row

scenarios.name: duplicate-prescription
scenarios.why: seed.sql holds the same key (patient 1, prescription 1, 2026-11-10 00:00:00): the INSERT is -803, '90'

scenarios.name: twice-a-day
scenarios.why: frequency 2, a one-day span: 2 PRESCRIPTION rows at the WHEN 2 times

scenarios.name: three-times-a-day
scenarios.why: frequency 3, a one-day span: 3 PRESCRIPTION rows at the WHEN 3 times

scenarios.name: four-times-a-day
scenarios.why: frequency 4, a one-day span: 4 PRESCRIPTION rows at the WHEN 4 times

scenarios.name: no-commarea
scenarios.why: EIBCALEN 0: WRITE-ERROR-MESSAGE (LINK HCAZERRS) then ABEND HCCA

scenarios.name: short-commarea
scenarios.why: one byte under the 18-byte header: '98', RETURN before the loop
